g.text: [non-transactional TStor: the body runs alone, nothing below]
[under the lock: a peer may have committed]
max_size = the Size a checked .changes lists, else None
[a backend that cannot seek reads past max_size]
[copy stopped at the cap; staged transfer discarded]
[.changes upload, not --skip-verify, and digests differ from its entry]
prune expired history under the lock
[retention set; a failure is logged, not raised]
